_help: Instant-answer intents for the fast path in app/conversation/agent.py. ONLY static, non-personalized facts and generic conversational turns belong here as answerable intents -- anything needing a real member/claim/benefit/pharmacy lookup must be listed under out_of_scope_examples instead, so the classifier learns to send it to the normal LLM/tool-calling path. After editing, run: python train_instant_answer_model.py

intents.answer: Prior authorization is required for certain medications, mainly Tier 3 and Tier 4 drugs. Your doctor's office submits the request with clinical justification -- standard review takes 3 to 5 business days, or 24 hours if it's marked urgent. If it's denied, you have the right to appeal.
examples: how long does prior auth take
how do I get a prior authorization
who submits the prior auth request
how many days for prior authorization approval
prior auth mein kitna time lagta hai
explain the prior authorization process to me
how does the PA process work

intents.answer: Generic medications have the same active ingredients as the brand-name version and are approved as equally safe and effective. Because they're cheaper, they're usually Tier 1 with the lowest copay -- ask your pharmacist if a generic is available for any brand-name prescription.
examples: what's the difference between generic and brand medications
is generic the same as brand name
are generics as good as brand name drugs
should I switch to a generic
is there a generic version available
generic aur brand mein kya fark hai
explain generic versus brand name drugs

intents.answer: If you take a maintenance medication, you can enroll in the mail-order pharmacy program for a 90-day supply shipped to your home, often at a reduced copay. You can enroll through the member portal or by calling customer service, and the first shipment usually arrives within 7 to 10 business days.
examples: how does the mail order pharmacy program work
can I get my medication mailed to me
how do I enroll in mail order pharmacy
how long does mail order delivery take
what is the mail order program
do you offer home delivery for medications
tell me about the mail order pharmacy option

intents.answer: Specialty medications -- complex drugs for conditions like rheumatoid arthritis, MS, or certain cancers -- are managed through a dedicated specialty pharmacy program. They almost always need prior authorization, are Tier 4 by default, and a specialty-trained pharmacist supports you with storage and administration.
examples: what is the specialty medication program
do specialty medications need prior authorization
who helps me with my specialty medication
specialty dawai ke liye kya karna hoga
what counts as a specialty medication

intents.answer: If a claim is rejected or a prior authorization is denied, you or your doctor can file a formal appeal within 180 days of the denial notice. A standard appeal is reviewed within 30 days, or 72 hours if it's urgent. If that's denied too, you have the right to an independent external review.
examples: how do I appeal a denied claim
how long do I have to file an appeal
how long does an appeal take
what happens if my appeal is denied again
can I appeal a rejected prior authorization
denied claim ka appeal kaise karte hain
explain how to appeal a denial
what's the deadline for filing an appeal

intents.answer: Using an in-network pharmacy is required for your standard copay to apply. If you use an out-of-network pharmacy, you'll typically pay full price up front and submit for reimbursement afterward, which is often only partially reimbursed.
examples: what happens if I use an out of network pharmacy
what if my pharmacy is not in network
do I get reimbursed for out of network pharmacy
is using an out of network pharmacy more expensive
out of network pharmacy use karne se kya hota hai
what's the difference between in network and out of network pharmacy cost
